description: Freshness limits for the published feeds, shared by scripts/check_feed_freshness.py and server/watchdog.ts. A source is degraded when its status is anything but ok (stale, retained, failed, missing). Its degraded age is how old its data was when the feed was built. A critical kind fails the check only when every source of that kind in one feed (one region) is degraded past critical_degraded_hours; a critical source past the limit while others of its kind are fine is reported without failing, and other kinds only warn. required_kinds (optional, per feed) lists the critical kinds that feed must carry at least one source of: a listed kind with no source in the feed is missing and fails like a wholly degraded kind, while a critical kind the feed does not list is not applicable and stays quiet when absent. The live conditions feeds (top-level and per region) carry buoys only, so they require observation; the daily data feed assembles all four kinds (as scripts/check_region_promotion.mjs already expects). max_age_hours is the fallback when a feed does not publish its own schedule.max_delay_hours. regions describes the per-region live feeds: ids come from dist/regions/index.json, and the default region is checked as the top-level conditions feed (its alias). coast describes the Morro Bay coast feeds: server/coast-data.ts takes each max_age_hours as its age limit and dist/status-page.js shows one row per listed source against it.
